title: Bihar STET Online Form 2026 – Start

ageLimit: As published in the official notification

shortDescription: Bihar STET Online Form 2026 – Start. See the official notice at www.bsebstet.com.
content:
Bihar School Examination Board has published an update for Bihar State Teacher Eligibility Test (STET). Confirm the current eligibility, fee and dates in the linked notice.

How to apply

  1. Open www.bsebstet.com
  2. Complete registration / OTR if required
  3. Fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee
  4. Print the confirmation page
